subject: [hw] DONE V16 rev 4 (restart verification + one branch-decode fix)
body:
V16 (T32 32-bit load/store, exclusive, table branch, branches, system) resumed after the 14:05 worker restart from the existing files, re-verified the package and fixed one branch-decode defect.  Host-tested only; nothing was run on the phone, nothing was published.

    $ bash gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v16/run_tests.sh
    V16 checks 3284977
    N2TEST V16 PASS 3284977/3284977      (ASan+UBSan, -O1)
    V16 checks 3284977
    N2TEST V16 PASS 3284977/3284977      (-O2, no sanitizers)

New since rev 3 (implementation): B<c>.W in the T3 space with cond == 111x now returns N2A32_UNDEF.  cond 1110 had been decoded as a 25-bit B.W, but the T3 space allocates conditions 0000-1101 only: B.W is the 25-bit T4 form whose second halfword has bit 12 set, and llvm-objdump and gdb both decode the cond-1110 T3 word as undefined (cond 1111 is the UDF/unallocated space).  The regression test derives both words from a generated `bne.w` by replacing the condition nibble, so no encoding is hand-typed, and checks that neither branches.

Differential harness (new evidence, /tmp only): with hw-r1's review/r1/v14-fix.patch applied in a /tmp copy of the restart tree, the nine V16 kernels pass 180/180 calls in thumb-O0, thumb-O2, thumb-O3v, arm-O0, arm-O2 and arm-O3v; the whole thumb-O0 row is 2780/2780.  armv8-O3v fails 20 calls only in k_v16_atomic, which there is A32 LDREXD/STREXD (V12's class).  Without the V14 patch the thumb rows still fail for many packages (e.g. k_v16_switch_wide stops at a 16-bit CBZ), which had masked V16; the tree itself was not modified.

Kernel file: emu/test_v16/k_v16_mem.c (nine k_v16_* functions).  It is still not installed as tests/emu/kernels/k14_v16_mem.c because that directory belongs to hw-t01; posted to hw-t01 again today.

R1 accepted V16 earlier (F9 and F13 fixed and re-checked); no open V16 finding.  Files touched (all owned): emu/n2a32_t32_mem.c (documentation only), emu/n2a32_t32_misc.c (cond fix), emu/test_v16/t_v16.c, emu/test_v16/STATUS.md, dsh-state/workers/V16/STATUS.md.  Deliberate UNDEF list and limits unchanged and in emu/test_v16/STATUS.md: LDM/STM empty/SP/Rn=15, LDRD/STRD Rt/Rt2=15, TBB/TBH Rm=15, exclusive with r15, byte/halfword store pc, ops 6/7/14/15, 0xF9C/D, register offset Rm=15, every coprocessor form except MRC p15,0,Rt,c13,c0,3, cond 111x, 16-bit words; no alignment checks, no MMU translate bit, hints/barriers are no-ops.
